name: AI Film Master Guide API

meta.notes: Static files on any static host — no auth, no keys, no rate limits. Breaking changes ship as a new v2/ path, never a silent shape change. Date-only fields are YYYY-MM-DD; timestamps are ISO-8601 UTC.

for_agents: Start at data/v1/index.json. For task procedures, read skills/index.json and load the relevant skill file — skills are the primary agentic interface for doing work, the JSON endpoints are the data layer. Repo-level agent guide: AGENT.md.
provenance: Compiled from the 2026-10-10 mega-research pass (Higgsfield pricing page read live; competition details from official sources). Unverified values are listed explicitly, never invented.

skills.usage: Each skill is a markdown file with frontmatter (name, description), then: Use when, Inputs, Procedure, Worked example, API references, Pitfalls. Load the skill whose task matches the user's request.

index.description: Manifest: every endpoint with description, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts, and deprecation notes. Start here.
index.notes: Self-describing; meta.version is the manifest version.

models.description: Model records: platform, type, credit costs, strengths, weaknesses, best use, per-model last_verified, status (active/reported/announced/discontinued), what_changed, sources; explicit unverified list.
models.notes: DEPRECATION: Sora carries status='discontinued' (service shut Mar-Sep 2026; API closed 2026-09-24). Discontinued models are excluded from the Studio and compare-tool pools but kept here for the historical record.

prompt-templates.description: Prompt templates: id, title, track, prompt, anatomy, use, models. Stable ids; [BRACKETS] placeholders.
prompt-templates.notes: 15 core (t1-t15), 8 animated (a1-a8), 8 photorealistic (p1-p8), 5 performance, 4 audio, 4 longform, 3 repair.

camera-movements.description: Camera lexicon: id, move, prompt_phrasing, when_to_use.

checklists.description: Production checklists (pre-production, per-shot, continuity, audio, delivery) with item arrays.

glossary.description: AI film / production terms: term + definition.

competitions.description: Judged competitions as craft records: what each judges, the production constraints its rules teach, craft lessons from judged work. No prizes, deadlines, or promotional material.

teardowns.description: Shot-by-shot teardowns: setup, what works, what breaks, craft lesson per shot; prompt reconstructions are analytical, not actual prompts.

diagnoses.description: Failure-diagnosis map for the Doctor tool: symptom -> craft diagnosis, fixes, repair-template link, source chapters.

model-checks.description: Model-watch freshness feed: per-model last check time, source-signature diffs, news headlines. Maintained by the model-watch refresh loop.
model-checks.notes: A 'changed' flag is a review signal, not a confirmed model change — check the review queue before treating it as fact.

model-history.description: Watchtower 2.0 event log: dated status, price, tier, release, verification, and coverage events for every tracked model, plus the pricing baseline the drift engine diffs the live pricing table against. Hand-authored — every event traces to models.json or model-updates.md.
model-history.notes: Price events carry before/after only where the record documents both numbers. The baseline is the pricing table as curated 2026-10-11.

model-review-queue.description: Pending model-watch review items: changed source signatures awaiting human promotion. Empty array = nothing pending.

model-review-log.description: Watchtower review log: the adjudication record for checker flags and failed sources. Each pass re-fetches the flagged URLs and records a verdict with its basis — a cleared queue is an audited queue. Hand-authored.
model-review-log.notes: Nothing in models.json moves without a verdict here (or a documented promotion in model-updates.md).

model-updates.description: Human-readable changelog of model record updates, with dates and sources.
